overview.financeHint: Payments, invoices and refunds are grouped under Finances.

identityHelp.sectionSubtitle: Two steps are required to complete the sponsor’s identity.
identityHelp.adminRoleTitle: Administration’s role: complete contact details without submitting the form.
identityHelp.adminRoleBody: You can add or correct contact details. Only the sponsor can submit their form through their follow-up access.
identityHelp.submissionRequired: To complete the Identity step, contact details must be complete and the sponsor must have submitted their form. Even if you fill in every field, the step still awaits this submission; you cannot validate it on their behalf.
identityHelp.coordinatesComplete: The organization name and contact email are present.
identityHelp.coordinatesMissing: Enter the missing organization name and contact email.
identityHelp.submitted: The form has been submitted by the sponsor.
identityHelp.submissionPending: The sponsor must submit their form through their private follow-up access.
identityHelp.ownerHelp: If the sponsor has lost their link, ask an owner to resend follow-up access.

media.noGallery: No media workspace is linked to this dossier.
media.logoEmptyHelp: Add the logo to complete the profile. Uploading it does not publish the sponsorship.
media.photosEmptyHelp: Ask the sponsor to add a presentation photo through their follow-up form, then review its permissions and content here.
